decisions.reason: The accelerator program is relatively distant from the firm's core recycling technology and its early results are harder to interpret and improve through the firm's existing R&D, so it is more likely to be dropped.
The bitumen binder lies outside the firm's core machinery and plastic/used-oil waste expertise, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the product, making it a likely drop.
This plant is close to the firm's established modular waste treatment technology, so the firm can readily interpret results and apply its R&D to improve it, making it likely to keep.
As a mobile mechanical recycling plant, it directly builds on the firm's core recycling machinery knowledge, ensuring high absorptive capacity and low drop probability.
